scope: Numerical convergence diagnosis of the unchanged posterior-credit estimator; consumed data only
prior: unchanged iid Jeffreys Beta(0.5,0.5); same original seed+replicate Sobol stream
budget: unchanged K4 total16 uniform4 per thought
geometry: all seven original fixed Grams; same four primary Grams
scalar_control: retain original frozen coefficient; never refit on outcomes or at new levels
integration: pool joint numerator/mass; exact24-permutation symmetrization of integrals equivalent to augmenting support; chunked nested prefixes
numerical_stability: highest-level half-scramble max credit difference <=0.02 AND highest-vs-previous max credit difference <=0.01 AND max stress risk change normalized by plug-in risk <=0.01
mean_and_stress_rules: retain original >5% development reductions against both controls and no >10% weighted risk regression vs plug-in in any of24 original primary stress cells
decision: largest-level stability fails: NUMERICALLY_INCONCLUSIVE; stable but mean/stress rules fail: STOP_POSTERIOR_CREDIT_AFTER_CONVERGENCE; stable and all development rules pass: DEVELOPMENT_CRITERIA_MET_NOT_CONFIRMED
ceiling: run all four declared levels; no adaptive extension or winner-level selection
uncertainty: exact outcome-state risks for each numerical table; quadrature stability is diagnostic, not a rigorous continuous-prior error certificate; no fresh population intervals

original_protocol.scope: Development feasibility of a concrete credit estimator; previous allocator gates unchanged
original_protocol.allocation: uniform 4 reward samples per thought, all samples used; no pilot allocation
original_protocol.target: sample-std normalized conditional Bernoulli values with floor tau=1e-4; h_tau(p)
original_protocol.runtime_information: count vector, fixed count per group, frozen prior lookup only; no true p, score-Gram or unavailable outcomes

prior_fit.exchangeability: augment each support point with all24 coordinate permutations; equal weights

original_protocol.scale_control: single clipped scalar minimizing frozen finite-prior predictive update risk averaged over the same four primary fixed Grams; fit before reading development outcomes
original_protocol.grams: all seven frozen matrices from experiments.gradient_gate.core.grams; no new geometry
original_protocol.primary_estimand: mean fixed-Gram update MSE over four primary geometries and96 consumed vectors; equal mixture components; ratio of means
original_protocol.development_rule: Candidate requires >5% reduction vs both plug-in and frozen scale control, no >10% weighted exact-risk regression vs plug-in in any six stress regimes and four primary Grams, and half-support maximum credit-table difference <=0.02; otherwise stop this prototype
original_protocol.uncertainty: No fresh intervals. Outcome risks exact; continuous prior integration approximate. Bayes optimality holds only for the frozen finite support and fixed score geometry independent of unknown p
original_protocol.no_rescue: one prior, one estimator, one budget; no hyperparameter tuning, winner-selected geometry, distribution change or new confirmation
